scope: Exactly20 Aave questions ×3 completed ordinary-KV arms. Actual raw, frozen gold, source evidence windows and per-question supplied contexts checked after root COMPLETE+EXPORT. No inference or raw/input/scorer changes.

criteria.content_correct: Substantive requested facts/data and explanation, independent of JSON formatting/status/citation metrics. Malformed JSON can pass only where the answer remains unambiguous and not contradicted. No raw repair.
criteria.citation_supported: Requires supplied source_id plus valid exact quote(s) establishing every requested fact; a generic/irrelevant exact quote or a bare R1 reference fails. Closed content is evaluated independently of its absent sources/citations.
criteria.unexpected_or_contradictory_claims: Substantive contradictions and unsupported extra facts fail content. Frozen ambiguous rule uses provisional false pending root adjudication.
